adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `GroupsController#members` changed from `render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)` (a bare JSON array) to `render json: { members: ..., meta: ... }` (object with `members` + `meta`). There is no compatibility shim (e.g., keeping the old array shape, alternate endpoint, or versioning) shown in the diff, so any external consumer expecting an array would indeed break. This is an API compatibility concern rather than an internal correctness defect, since the PR also updates the JS client (`findMembers` now reads `result.members`/`result.meta`).
